judge.why: P3 says there is no management agreement and no managing-agent fee in the first-year budget, and that the Sponsor manages the condominium while it controls the Board. P10 calls the Sponsor the 'de facto managing agent' during the Sponsor Control Period, so B is accurate. P4 does say the Board of Managers, which the Sponsor initially controls, is responsible for first-year management, and the no-fee part of A is correct. But calling it 'self-managed by Board' leaves out the Sponsor as the party actually managing, so A is only close.
